literature_function: GPI-anchored IgLON family cell adhesion molecule that regulates neurite outgrowth, synapse number and dendritic spine architecture.
literature_critical_note: NEGR1 is an adhesion molecule, not a release-machinery protein. Its links to vesicle biology are interactome-level (PMID 40382479) and have not been shown to alter release itself. Direction of effect is bidirectional in the literature: both knockout (PMID 30651602) and overexpression (PMID 40382479) impair synaptic function, so a simple more-is-better or less-is-better model is not supported.
literature_species: mouse/rat cortical neurons, cell culture;rat cultured hippocampal neurons

literature_primary_compartment: both, but not synapse-specific (exocyst subunit Sec8; general polarised membrane delivery)
literature_function: Subunit of the octameric exocyst complex that tethers secretory vesicles to specific plasma-membrane sites before SNARE-mediated fusion.
literature_critical_note: EXOC4 is the weakest synapse-specific gene in this set. The exocyst is a general polarised-trafficking machine, and the cleanest genetic test (Drosophila sec5, PMID 12575951) explicitly dissociates exocyst function from neurotransmitter release. Its neuronal specificity, where it exists, is postsynaptic receptor delivery (PMIDs 12738960, 16601687), not presynaptic release. Most evidence is for Sec8 and Sec5 rather than for human EXOC4 by name.

literature_function: ATPase that disassembles cis-SNARE complexes to recycle fusion machinery, and separately binds GluA2 to sustain synaptic AMPA receptors.
literature_critical_note: NSF is genuinely dual-compartment, which makes locus-level inference ambiguous: a cognition association at NSF could act through presynaptic SNARE recycling or through postsynaptic AMPA receptor maintenance. NSF also lies on chromosome 17q21.31, next to the MAPT/KANSL1 inversion polymorphism (PMID 22751100 characterises that inversion), but whether NSF itself falls inside the inverted interval was NOT confirmed from the sources read here: UNVERIFIED, and it should be checked against coordinates before any LD-based claim is made.
